combo_label: Barbecues × Musical Instruments × The Domesday Book

entries.clue: Smoky sweet sticky bottled stuff, brushed on late so its sugar cannot burn
Grinding works turned by a stream, some six thousand recorded
Italian marking that puts the bow back on the strings
Knives and forks, the flimsy plastic kind that bends on the first mouthful
Slogan-printed garment tied at the waist to keep fat off a clean shirt
Teardrop body, paired strings, and a shivering tremolo picked in bluegrass
Peasant with a hut and a scrap of ground, low in the recorded ranks
Cremona family credited with shaping the very first fiddle
Cupped in both palms and slid along the lips, sounding on blow and on draw
Unfree peasant holding land in return for labour for his lord
